responsibility: Defines the `ty` module’s query interface layer: it declares the set of `TyCtxt` query entry points and their provider signatures, owns the query-system storage wrappers (`QuerySystem`, caches/arenas wiring), and generates the `TyCtxt`, `TyCtxtAt`, `ensure`, and feed APIs that connect type-context requests to dependency-tracked, memoized query execution.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `mir/query.rs` and `traits/query.rs`, which mainly define particular query result or interface types for MIR analyses and trait solving respectively, this file is the crate-wide query infrastructure layer. It declares the `TyCtxt` query API surface, provider traits, cache/arena wiring, and the generated `at`/`ensure`/feed plumbing that executes and memoizes all queries, including those whose payload types are declared in the other `query.rs` files.
